notes: No Confession is available before Mass.
The parish office and gates are closed on Public Holidays.

info.adoration: Adoration Room is open Mon - Sun from 07:00am to 11:00pm. It is closed on Public Holidays after 09:00am Mass.
info.confession: Contact Parish Office to make an appointment.
info.office_hours: Parish Office is open Mon - Fri from 09:30am to 06:30pm and Sat - Sun from 08:30am to 01:00pm. It is closed on Public Holidays.
good_to_know: The Main Gate and Back Gate are open Mon - Sun from 05:00am to 11:00pm. They are closed on Public Holidays after 09:00am Mass.
The Columbarium is open Mon - Fri from 10:00am to 07:30pm and Sat - Sun from 08:30am to 07:30pm. It is closed on Public Holidays.
Mass on Public Holidays is held at 09:00am.

events.title: 520th Birth Anniversary of St Francis Xavier
events.text: Join us from 25 Nov to 6 Dec outside JPII Hall as we celebrate his remarkable life and missionary journeys. Children can enjoy stamping and craft activities, or even dress up as St Francis Xavier or King John III of Portugal.

events.title: OYP: NS Community Outreach
events.text: Join us for a time of prayer, sharing, and fellowship over two dates. Dinner starts at 7:00pm at the Church of the Holy Spirit (Room 03-14).

events.title: OYP: Seeds of Growth
events.text: Calling all A-levels/IB students and graduating Secondary School students. Come join us for a time of prayer, sharing, and fellowship over two dates at Level 8, Catholic Centre.
